up: Return the canonical SMILES, standard relation, standard value, and standard units for all activity records associated with assay CHEMBL1613808.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT cs.canonical_smiles, a.standard_relation, a.standard_value, a.standard_units FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1613808'
